repository_ledger_location.locator_form: kv://_StegVerse/Receipts on the KV instance STEGVERSE_KV (KV instance -> storage endpoint -> access adapter -> location; KV #2 request lineage SITE-CLOUD-KV-4347408852127319cbda574f02e03edb); read back as HEAD.json + receipts/<sha256 hex>.json
repository_ledger_location.designation_source: KV-SKAP-LEDGER-LOCATION-001 under KV-SKAP-VAULT-FUNCTIONAL-001 (StegVerse-Labs/.github#3324), designated by StegVerse-Labs/continuity-vault-kit per StegVerse-org/.github#167 comment 6372442705 (Coordination correction; defers to cvk docs/KV_AI_PERSISTENCE_LAYOUTS.md, KV_STORAGE_ENDPOINT_V2_MIRROR_HANDOFF.md and SKAP_PORTABLE_ENVELOPE_V2_MIRROR_HANDOFF.md @bcc2d75): STEGVERSE_KV's recorded receipt chain ('kv'): KV layer-1 receipts (stegverse.kv-access-receipt/v1, INTR_DEVICE_KV), at the STEGVERSE_KV receipt_root _StegVerse/Receipts (specs/kv-ai-persistence-layouts.v1.json). KV is independent of the Orgs and keeps its own recorded receipt chains behind its own InTr endpoint; they are never stored on any Org ledger ref. 'repository' STEGVERSE_KV is the KV class/instance (logical root _StegVerse/), not a GitHub repository; 'ref' KV_INTR_ENDPOINT is the only access route; the namespace is the documented in-KV location. Storage is the documented KV Storage Endpoint v2 model (runtime/kv_storage_provider_adapter.py, stegverse.kv.storage-endpoint-descriptor/v2): STEGVERSE_KV is the existing Google Drive KV #2 lineage SITE-CLOUD-KV-4347408852127319cbda574f02e03edb (PENDING_INTERLOCK_INTR; not regenerated, rehashed or treated as executed). The provider is not authority. Same repository_ledger_location keys as StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter#431; new_ledger_root true because this is KV's own chain root, not a subtree of an Org ledger.
repository_ledger_location.initialization: Genesis is a REPOSITORY_LEDGER_INITIALIZATION transition for STEGVERSE_KV:_StegVerse/Receipts whose first receipt has previous_receipt_sha256 null, computed by KV on its own side and recorded at _StegVerse/Receipts only after InTr admission. An empty storage location is never taken as a genesis.
repository_ledger_location.rule: KV computes every receipt of this chain from its own side and replays it from _StegVerse/Receipts back to genesis; it never reads an Org ledger to replay it. CORRESPONDENCE_NOT_STORAGE: an Org/KV interaction is two linked receipts, one in each side's own chain, linked by receipt_sha256; neither ledger is copied across the boundary, and a receipt naming another repository is refused (KV_RECEIPT_CHAIN_FOREIGN_RECORD_REFUSED). The storage provider's own records (file ids, revisions, owners, sharing, metadata files) never cross into KV (EXTERNAL_STORAGE_RECORD_REFUSED). Rollback: the head is signed by a published kv_ledger_head_signer, and the newest head KV itself recorded on its own receipt chain (KV_RECORDED_RECEIPT_CHAIN_HEAD) must stay on the read-back chain (KV_LEDGER_HEAD_ROLLBACK_DETECTED); the watermark never comes from the Org ledger (KV_ROLLBACK_WATERMARK_ORG_LEDGER_SOURCED). Order lives in KV's receipt chain, never in a provider's file history. The MyKV AI Assistant (WORKSPACE_ASSISTANT) proposes; it never transitions this chain (every mutation needs InTr admission).
repository_ledger_location.expected_genesis_note: Null on purpose. Per #167 comment 6372442705 item 6 the genesis pin is computed in advance once #431's genesis aligns with SUPPLIED_HB_EPOCH (StegVerse-Labs/.github#3263/#3290, Lane B); pin-after-observe (#162 comment 6371352606) stays only as the read-back check. Until then every read is FAIL_CLOSED KV_RECEIPT_CHAIN_GENESIS_NOT_PINNED; an unpinned genesis is never accepted.

designation_notes.store_type_note: KV_STORAGE_ENDPOINT (proposed to Lane B; #167 comment 6372442705: KV Storage Endpoint v2 names only): one documented KV Storage Endpoint v2 descriptor (runtime/kv_storage_provider_adapter.py default_registry(); provider_id, access_adapter as there) plus the KV instance, the KV #2 request lineage and the in-KV location. No new adapter interface, no ledger-wide encryption.
designation_notes.path_ids_note: The rollback watermark is KV's own recorded receipt chain head (KV_RECORDED_RECEIPT_CHAIN_HEAD, the head kv_ledger_head_signer signs, StegVerse-Labs/TVC#542 @4c2504da): KV is independent of the Orgs (Coordination's provisional class A repair, StegVerse-org/.github#167; C-review pending). The reader reads it itself from KV's own append-only head record (.stegverse/node-ledger/head-record.v1.jsonl; absent or malformed: KV_LEDGER_HEAD_ROLLBACK_WATERMARK_MISSING, class A; regressed: DENY KV_LEDGER_HEAD_ROLLBACK_DETECTED; LC-KV-23 class A per StegVerse-org/.github#167 comment 6374130335); a caller's recorded_head is only a claim; a watermark or designation sourced from the Org ledger is refused KV_ROLLBACK_WATERMARK_ORG_LEDGER_SOURCED (class A). The intr-destination path_ids (proposed in StegVerse-org/.github#235 @f84b97c1's declared_paths form, not yet declared) appear only under the required org_crossing_cross_check: the reader obtains the Org's digest-only crossing record itself and compares it only to refuse (newer or non-ancestor head: DENY KV_LEDGER_HEAD_ROLLBACK_DETECTED; not observable after a crossing: FAIL_CLOSED KV_CROSSING_RECORD_NOT_OBSERVED, class B; never crossed: skipped at E0), authority NONE, never the watermark; the Org never grants.
designation_notes.refuses: Any org ledger ref or git-ref designation (store_type GIT_REF, StegVerse-org/.github, refs/stegverse/organization-ledger, repository-ledger/...): KV_RECEIPT_CHAIN_DESIGNATED_ON_ORG_LEDGER. Any store_type other than KV_STORAGE_ENDPOINT: KV_RECEIPT_CHAIN_STORE_NOT_STORAGE_ENDPOINT_V2. More than one store: ENDPOINT_LEDGER_MULTI_PROVIDER_NOT_SUPPORTED. Any key outside the closed schema runtime.kv_receipt_ledgers.CONTRACT_KEY_SCHEMA: ENDPOINT_ORG_MEMBERSHIP_REFUSED when membership-like, else KV_RECEIPT_CHAIN_DESIGNATION_UNKNOWN_KEY (LC-KV-24). A rollback_watermark_source (or read input) sourced from the Org ledger rather than KV_RECORDED_RECEIPT_CHAIN_HEAD: KV_ROLLBACK_WATERMARK_ORG_LEDGER_SOURCED (class A).
designation_notes.org_crossing_receipts: No KV or SKAP Vault recorded receipt chain is on any Org organization-ledger ref (LC-KV-21, StegVerse-org/.github#163 comment 6372658597). The Org ledger carries only digest-only InTr crossing receipts: a pointer/digest plus SUPPLIED_HB_EPOCH, where the digest is KV_RECORDED_RECEIPT_CHAIN_HEAD (the head_receipt_sha256 signed by kv_ledger_head_signer, StegVerse-Labs/TVC#542 @4c2504da).
designation_notes.org_membership: No endpoint (KV, SKAP Vault, node or gateway) is ever a GitHub Organization member (Rigel's rule, via Coordination on StegVerse-org/.github#160). STEGVERSE_KV is the KV class, not a GitHub repository: no org repository, no org-membership, team or app-installation binding, no org ref. KV reaches the Orgs only through InTr (KV_INTR_ENDPOINT, intr-destination path_ids). Any such binding: ENDPOINT_ORG_MEMBERSHIP_REFUSED.
